(i) The Tokugawa family held the office of shogun from: (1)
(ii) Explain the term 'shogun' as it relates to this theme. (1)
(iii) Explain the reason behind the following: The shogun could control the daimyo. (2)
items.answer: (i) 1603 to 1867 (ii) The military ruler of Japan who exercised real power in the name of the emperor. (iii) The daimyo were ordered to live at the capital for long periods and could not easily rebel.
items.markingKey: 1+1+2 marks: (i) 1603 to 1867 (ii) The military ruler of Japan who exercised real power in the name of the emperor. (iii) The daimyo were ordered to live at the capital for long periods and could not easily rebel.
